responsibility: Holds LTO streamer utilities shared by both reader and writer. It owns global LTO statistics, the selected section-name prefix for normal versus offload streaming, tag-to-name decoding for bytecode diagnostics, construction of unique object-file section names from section kind and symbol names, common streamer initialization, the global gate deciding whether LTO streaming passes run, version compatibility checks, and installation of tree/location streaming hooks. This file is the common support layer for the LTO streamer subsystem rather than a reader-only or writer-only implementation.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable support routines for the lto-streamer interface declared in gcc/lto-streamer.h, such as global LTO statistics/state, section-name construction, tag-to-name decoding, version checks, pass gating, and streamer hook initialization.
